messagesReason: The family has no catalog of its own. A key's legend where the platform writes a word, the name a screen reader hears, and the then between two steps of a sequence come from the shared keys catalog of the language in force, which command-palette and menu read for the same keys; only the marks (⌘ ⇧ ↩ ←) stay in core, because they read the same in every language. legends and names stay per-token content overrides; messages lays words over the catalog.
